_note: Accepted plan_audit failure counts per category. A run at or below its athlete's accepted counts logs a success; a new category or a higher count alerts. Shrink these as the defects in docs/plan-audit-status.md are fixed (or regenerate with plan_audit.py --all --write-baseline); an empty map for an athlete means every hard fail alerts. SKIPPED is a category like any other, so it MUST be listed even at 0 — omitting it made get(cat,-1) reject every run and alerted all three athletes daily from the moment the category was added (28 Jul 2026). RULES now includes the three checks armed on 28 Jul (weekly_tss_cap / weekly_tss_floor / run_weekly_volume), which is why the counts went UP while SKIPPED went to ~0: those failures were always there, they were just never being checked. DIRECTED (28 Jul 2026) is the coach-directed day_rules deviations register (athletes/<slug>/reference/day-rules-overrides.json): reported, never hard. Like SKIPPED it MUST be listed even at 0, or get(cat,-1) rejects every run. jamie RULES 7->6 because his Wednesday swim was DIRECTED and moved category; the three UNDIRECTED breaches (Thu ride, Thu brick run, Fri run) are still in RULES and still hard, which is why RULES was shrunk rather than left at 7.
